caliper-caption-rail.avoid_when: Do not use it for 16x9, because its aspects declaration does not include 16x9 and the header makes the 1080x1920 portrait format non-negotiable.
caliper-caption-rail.use_when: A portrait shot needs a large axial measurement label physically aligned with a long, narrow object.
caliper-caption-rail.what: A specification callout opens along a measurement rail, then the instrument rotates 90 degrees onto a long object axis and locks the type against it.

caption-camera-follow.avoid_when: Avoid placing scripts outside the composition root, because the host copies that markup without its behavior and produces a black card with no timeline.
caption-camera-follow.use_when: A sentence must accumulate word by word while each arrival reads at roughly the same screen size.
caption-camera-follow.what: New words stay fixed on an expanding page while the camera pulls back exponentially until the complete sentence is readable.

chevron-pill-card-morph.avoid_when: Do not use it when verified 16x9 support is required, because its aspects declaration does not include 16x9.
chevron-pill-card-morph.use_when: A compact search or selection control must remain visibly continuous as it expands into a checkout-style card.
chevron-pill-card-morph.what: One surface changes from a circle to a pill to a card while one accent element stretches from a chevron disc into the card action bar.

depth-rack-focus.avoid_when: Avoid it when animated blur is unacceptable, because blur on the foreground and message planes is the stated focus mechanic.
depth-rack-focus.use_when: Attention must transfer once from a near plane to a message on a far plane.

variables.description: Small line above the message.
variables.name: kicker

variables.description: The message the focus resolves onto.
variables.name: headline

variables.description: Foreground bokeh colour.
variables.name: accent

depth-rack-focus.what: A sharp foreground dissolves into bokeh as a blurred message behind it resolves while the whole stack creeps forward.

echo-trail.avoid_when: Avoid it when more than six ghosts or a lag outside 0.03 to 0.3 seconds is required, because echoes are limited to 2 through 6 and delta is clamped to that range.
echo-trail.use_when: One moving subject needs an onion-skin trail that shows its recent positions before a clean landing.

variables.description: Ghost copy count, clamped 2 to 6.
variables.name: echoes

variables.description: Lag between successive ghosts in seconds, clamped 0.03 to 0.3.
variables.name: delta

variables.description: Authored traversal preset.
variables.name: path

variables.description: Subject accent color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.
variables.name: accent

variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the settled element holds until the frame cuts.
variables.name: exit

echo-trail.what: A slotted subject travels along an authored path with lagged ghost copies that collapse into it and disappear at rest.

focus-rack.avoid_when: Avoid it when focus must alternate repeatedly, because the rack occurs exactly once over 0.7 seconds.
focus-rack.use_when: Two cards at different apparent depths need one clear handoff from the foreground state to the background state.

variables.description: Label on the card that begins in focus.
variables.name: label_a

variables.description: Label on the card that receives focus.
variables.name: label_b

variables.description: Highlight color shared by both cards.
variables.name: accent

focus-rack.what: Focus moves exactly once from a sharp near card to a blurred, dim far card as blur, scale, and parallax change together.

glyph-ring-assemble.avoid_when: Avoid it when every glyph must remain visible throughout the orbit, because a glyph crossing the central mark vanishes for about 0.3 seconds.
glyph-ring-assemble.use_when: A readable wordmark must break into individually staggered glyphs without leaving a single shared circular path.
glyph-ring-assemble.what: Arc-set letters leave a wordmark in reverse reading order, each completes one full orbit around a shared ring, and the letters close back into the word.

grade-split-reveal.avoid_when: Avoid it for text, SVG, or ordinary DOM content, because the documented color grading applies only to image and video media.
grade-split-reveal.use_when: The same image or video must show a direct before-and-after color comparison in one frame.
grade-split-reveal.what: A hard vertical edge sweeps left to right across two aligned copies of one plate, pauses at the midpoint for comparison, then reveals the graded copy across the full frame.

halftone-dissolve.avoid_when: Avoid cueing the dissolve so late that its 1.3-second transition and any exit cannot fit, because dissolve_at is clamped to keep both inside the clip.
halftone-dissolve.use_when: Two slotted scenes need a textured transition whose reveal can sweep left to right, grow from center, or scatter from a seeded map.

variables.description: Grid pitch for the halftone field.
variables.name: dot_size

variables.description: Threshold ordering: ltr sweeps left to right, center grows from the middle, noise scatters.
variables.name: direction

variables.description: Seconds from mount start when the dissolve begins.
variables.name: dissolve_at

variables.description: Ink dot color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.
variables.name: accent

variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: scene B holds until the frame cuts.
variables.name: exit

halftone-dissolve.what: Accent dots appear on a fixed grid, open into windows onto scene B, and merge until scene B replaces scene A.

kinetic-type-swap.avoid_when: Avoid it when the sentence may reflow during a swap, because the slot is pre-sized to the widest option and all options occupy one grid cell.
kinetic-type-swap.use_when: A headline must keep its prefix and suffix stationary while one word changes through several authored choices.

variables.description: Fixed sentence text before the rolling word slot.
variables.name: prefix

variables.description: Comma-separated words shown in the rolling slot.
variables.name: options

variables.description: Fixed sentence text after the rolling word slot.
variables.name: suffix

variables.description: Comma-separated seconds (from mount start) for each word swap. Empty keeps the authored even spread.
variables.name: cues

variables.description: Color used by the rolling word slot.
variables.name: accent

variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the sentence holds until the frame cuts.
variables.name: exit

kinetic-type-swap.what: A fixed sentence rolls one masked word slot vertically through a list of options without changing the sentence layout.

marker-highlight.avoid_when: Avoid it when the emphasized phrase must wrap, because the header requires the match to stay on one line.
marker-highlight.use_when: One specific word or short phrase in a single line needs a timed highlight, circle, underline, or scribble.

variables.description: Full line of display text.
variables.name: text

variables.description: First case-insensitive substring match in text receives the marker. Empty or unmatched draws no marker.
variables.name: emphasis_word

variables.description: Shape of the hand-drawn marker stroke.
variables.name: style

variables.description: Second (from mount start) the marker starts drawing. Clamped so the stroke completes before any exit.
variables.name: draw_at

variables.description: Marker ink color from the contract token map.
variables.name: accent

variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the lockup holds until the frame cuts.
variables.name: exit

marker-highlight.what: A short display line settles in, then one SVG marker stroke draws over the first matched word or phrase.

match-cut.avoid_when: Avoid it when a crossfade is required, because scene A becomes invisible and scene B visible at the same timeline instant.
match-cut.use_when: Two scenes share a circle that can carry motion continuously across a precise hard cut.

variables.description: Color shared by the matched circles.
variables.name: accent

variables.description: Text inside the outgoing button.
variables.name: label_a

variables.description: Result text revealed after the cut.
variables.name: label_b

match-cut.what: Scene A drives a circle into center-frame geometry, a hard single-frame swap reveals scene B with a matching circle, and that circle immediately shrinks as scene B settles.

orbit-ring-camera.avoid_when: Avoid it when square or portrait framing needs the same composition quality as landscape, because those aspects are only re-aimed while the move is composed for 16x9.
orbit-ring-camera.use_when: A close tracked journey along a loop must resolve into a complete system view with all stations visible.
orbit-ring-camera.what: A camera tracks a lit head around a tilted ring, then dollies out to reveal the full ellipse, eight stations, and three rotating inner rails.

particle-text-dissolve.avoid_when: Avoid the out direction when visible content must remain during the hold, because that direction ends on an empty stage.
particle-text-dissolve.use_when: A single text line must visibly form from particles or disintegrate into them with a left-to-right front.

variables.description: The line that assembles from (or dissolves into) the particle cloud.
variables.name: text

variables.description: in assembles the text from the cloud and holds it crisp; out erases the text into the cloud and holds empty.
variables.name: direction

variables.description: Particle count cap for the field.
variables.name: density

variables.description: Text and particle color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.
variables.name: accent

variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the end state holds until the frame cuts.
variables.name: exit

particle-text-dissolve.what: Seeded particles either assemble into a crisp text line or depart from that line into a fading cloud.

persona-card-fan.avoid_when: Avoid it when portrait or square framing must be as fully composed as landscape, because those aspects are only kept inside the frame and the move is composed for 16x9.
persona-card-fan.use_when: Options must appear beside a presenter while the deepest card stays pinned and newer cards subdivide the same fan.
persona-card-fan.what: Four portrait cards deal onto the right side one at a time while displaced cards scale and rotate into a fixed outer wedge that tightens as it fills.

pill-row-collapse.avoid_when: Avoid it when a label may be bisected during reveal, because the type-in clip is deliberately quantized to character boundaries.
pill-row-collapse.use_when: A five-stage process must narrow visibly to its first stage after all five labels have been shown together.
pill-row-collapse.what: Five labeled pills build left to right, hold for reading, then pills two through five spread and clear while the first pill glides to center and becomes active.

plan-room-audit.avoid_when: Avoid it when the shot must be natively composed for landscape, because the header states that it is native to 9x16 and composed only for that orientation.
plan-room-audit.use_when: A portrait floor-plan scene needs a room-by-room audit whose count stays synchronized with the filled rooms.
plan-room-audit.what: A floor plan sheet rotates clockwise into square while its walls draw, then five rooms fill and receive leader tags in reading order.

press-ripple.avoid_when: Avoid cueing the press outside the safe gesture window, because press_at is clamped so arrival, compression, ripple, and exit all fit inside the duration.
press-ripple.use_when: A caller-supplied interface target needs one explicit press gesture with a visible impact and release.

variables.description: Text inside the default pill target.
variables.name: label

variables.description: Zone center, percent of host width.
variables.name: target_x

variables.description: Zone center, percent of host height.
variables.name: target_y

variables.description: Seconds from mount start when the press begins.
variables.name: press_at

variables.description: Pointer tone.
variables.name: cursor

variables.description: Contract color for the ripple ink and pressed fill.
variables.name: accent

variables.description: How the frame leaves. None holds the pressed state.
variables.name: exit

press-ripple.what: A cursor decelerates onto a positioned target, compresses with it, releases two ripple rings, and exits while the pressed state remains.

rank-list-settle.avoid_when: Avoid it when the winner cannot be the last row, because the geometry parks only the last row on the focus line and requires that row to carry the winner class.
rank-list-settle.use_when: A comparison must build to one winner whose emphasis is determined by its physical position at the stop.

variables.description: The line the winning row lands on.
variables.name: title

rank-list-settle.what: A ranked list rolls upward under a fixed focus line, washes out passing rows, and stops with the final winning row fully lit on that line.

receipt-card.avoid_when: Avoid it when landscape must be the native composition, because the header identifies the card as 9x16 native and authors its safe zone for 9x16.
receipt-card.use_when: A portrait quote card needs one phrase marked in place after the card has landed.
receipt-card.what: A tilted quote card flies in from the right, settles flat, pushes in slowly, then fills selection boxes behind one phrase while the marked words turn white.

state-chip-rail.avoid_when: Avoid it when more than eight states or more than four badges are required, because extra states are dropped and badges are capped at four.
state-chip-rail.use_when: A discrete state machine needs seek-exact, instantaneous advances and optional badges beside one activated state.

variables.description: Comma-separated chip labels in machine order (2 to 8 states).
variables.name: states

variables.description: Comma-separated activation times in seconds, one per advance (state 1 onward). Blank entries use the default even rhythm.
variables.name: times

variables.description: Index of the state the badges pop beside.
variables.name: badge_state

variables.description: Comma-separated badge labels shown beside the badge state. Empty disables.
variables.name: badges

variables.description: Accent token family used by the active chip.
variables.name: accent

variables.description: How the rail leaves the frame. Default none: the hold ends the film.
variables.name: exit

state-chip-rail.what: A row of status chips snaps through ordered states on scheduled cues while active, completed, and pending chips take distinct appearances.

thread-message-stack.avoid_when: Avoid it when frame zero must be empty, because the thread deliberately opens on three settled bubbles.
thread-message-stack.use_when: A conversation must build through alternating incoming and outgoing bubbles while the background continues moving.

variables.description: base under the moving blobs and letterbox color for replacement footage.
variables.name: --tms-roll-bg

variables.description: outgoing bubble fill.
variables.name: --tms-out-fill

variables.description: outgoing bubble text color.
variables.name: --tms-out-ink

variables.description: incoming bubble fill.
variables.name: --tms-in-fill

variables.description: incoming bubble text color.
variables.name: --tms-in-ink

variables.description: sender tag text color.
variables.name: --tms-tag-ink

variables.description: bubble corner radius.
variables.name: --tms-radius

thread-message-stack.what: Message bubbles land on the bottom line over a moving background, push older messages upward under a mask, and show a typing pill before each incoming message.

version-plate-type.avoid_when: Avoid it when every word must retain its natural proportions, because resolved words are fitted to one constant ink width and the box separately changes width and height.
version-plate-type.use_when: A word sequence must read as text being manipulated one axis at a time by a visible selection box.
version-plate-type.what: Oversized glyph plates stamp into a cluster, hard-cut to fitted words inside a selection box, then the box widens, shortens, closes on the letters, and pushes off frame.

whiteboard-ink.avoid_when: Avoid supplying non-path slot content, because only path elements inside the strokes group become the drawing.
whiteboard-ink.use_when: A preset or caller-supplied SVG sketch needs sequential ink drawing with a traveling pen actor and a caption after completion.

variables.description: Authored preset sketch to draw. Ignored when the strokes slot holds custom paths.
variables.name: sketch

variables.description: Short line shown after the sketch completes.
variables.name: caption

variables.description: Show or hide the pen nib actor.
variables.name: pen

variables.description: Color used by strokes marked data-ink=accent (one highlight stroke in each preset).
variables.name: accent

variables.description: How the completed lockup leaves. none holds the final frame.
variables.name: exit

whiteboard-ink.what: SVG paths draw one stroke at a time while a pen nib follows each active path tip and hops between strokes.

z-punch-through.avoid_when: Avoid it when the clip needs a hold, because the documented 2.10-second envelope is filled by the move and has no hold.
z-punch-through.use_when: A scene change must feel like forward travel through an aperture rather than a flat scale zoom.

variables.description: Text on the wall the camera punches through.
variables.name: front

variables.description: Text on the plane behind the wall.
variables.name: back

variables.description: Light behind the aperture.
variables.name: accent

z-punch-through.what: The camera moves through an opening in a front wall as that wall passes the lens and the back plane advances into its settled state.
